# 2 Baruch Chapter 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**13:1** And-the-LORD said-to-me: "Baruch, I-have-heard-your-prayer and-your-lamentation is-known-to-me.

**13:2** But-I-say-to-you: whoever-is-able-to-endure-tribulation, and-yet-not-abandon-me — such-a-one shall-receive-a-crown.

**13:3** But-you-have-mourned-greatly on-account-of-Zion and-you-have-been-troubled for-her-sake.

**13:4** And-I-tell-you: do-not-set-your-heart on-the-prosperity-of-the-nations, lest-they-prevail-over-you.

**13:5** For-the-nations shall-be-punished in-due-time, just-as-they-have-sinned, and-their-punishment shall-come-in-their-time.

**13:6** But-as-for-you, set-not-your-heart on-the-nations, but-remember-well-your-works; for-after-your-works shall-your-reward-be-determined.

**13:7** For-I-will-not-forget-the-covenant-which-I-made-with-your-fathers, and-I-will-call-to-remembrance them-who-have-passed-away.

**13:8** For-great-are-the-things-which-the-Most-High-has-prepared-for-those-who-do-righteousness in-due-season.

**13:9** For-a-lamp-that-shines-within-a-house shall-be-extinguished-when-it-is-no-longer-needed; but-the-light-of-the-righteous-shall-shine-forever.

**13:10** And-now-therefore-be-encouraged and-prepare-yourself, and-continue-to-believe-me-and-trust-in-me; for-I-am-the-Mighty-One and-my-face-shall-not-be-hidden-from-you.

**13:11** But-the-light-of-the-morning shall-come-upon-you after-the-darkness, and-the-salvation-of-God-shall-come-to-those-who-wait.

**13:12** Prepare-yourself therefore for-what-shall-befall-you, and-remember-what-was-foretold-of-you; for-out-of-Zion-shall-the-Law-go-forth, and-out-of-Jerusalem-the-word-of-the-LORD."

---

*EMET notes: God's first major encouragement speech to Baruch. The light/dark imagery (vv.9-11) is central. V.12 quotes Isa 2:3 / Mic 4:2. "Most High" = Elyon.*
